title: I lost my job, so I made a zombie game instead of getting depressed. Turns out it's decent therapy
author: Jeronimoschreyer
selftext:
![video](uqgk2of0uj2i1 "Fight your way through!")

A few weeks ago I lost my job. Instead of spending my days in bed feeling sorry for myself, I decided to make a game. Two weeks later, here it is: **INFECTADOS** (Spanish for "infected"), a short narrative third-person shooter.   
  
It runs in the browser, on Windows and on Linux, supports keyboard/mouse and gamepad, and it's in English, Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese.   
  
It takes about 15 minutes to finish. I'd love to hear what you think, especially about the combat and whether the story lands. Bug reports are very welcome.   
  
Made with Godot 4.6   
[https://jair0.itch.io/infectados](https://jair0.itch.io/infectados)
